candidates.eligibility_note: NMN/NR are supplements, not approved drugs; niacinamide is approved — the eligible product/indication must be fixed
candidates.best_evidence: North BJ et al., EMBO J 2014, PMID 24825348 (SIRT2 deacetylates BubR1-K668). NOTE: NMN experiments were in aging/WT/Sirt2-null contexts; BubR1^H/H lifespan used a SIRT2 TRANSGENE. NMN untested in the MVA model.
candidates.disposition_reason: On-mechanism rationale is real, but the NMN/NR drug step is a bridging hypothesis unvalidated in the MVA model and in N1002K; oncology direction contested (raise BubR1 suppresses vs NAD+ fuels tumors).
candidates.decisive_experiment: In patient/isogenic N1002K cells: NAD+ precursor dose-response -> BubR1-K668 acetylation + total BubR1, mitotic timing, aneuploidy; PLUS clonal-fitness/transformation arm for the tumor-fuelling concern.

candidates.drug: PTC readthrough of L737X (DAP / ELX-02; aminoglycoside & ataluren rejected)
candidates.eligibility_note: ataluren lost approval (EMA non-renewal 2025-03-28; PTC withdrew FDA NDA application 2026-02-12); aminoglycosides INELIGIBLE here on renal grounds; ELX-02 investigational; DAP preclinical
candidates.best_evidence: Trzaska 2020 Nat Commun PMID 32198346 (DAP UGA readthrough); Toledano 2024 Nat Genet PMID 39174735 (genome-scale readthrough). Full-length restoration precedent is CFTR (Sharma 2021 PMID 34272367), not BUB1B.
candidates.disposition_reason: Corrected: readthrough gives a near-full-length product (old 'truncated' reason withdrawn). Coordinates recomputed (readthrough_coordinates_2026-10-08.md): stop UGA at c.2209-2211 (g.40209700-702), +1 context base = c.2212 = g.40209703 (raw log's c.2213 was off by one). Blocker = NMD (PREDICTED, not measured; needs allele-specific mRNA) + no renal-safe approved UGA agent. One-allele rescue judged by functional threshold, not allele count.
candidates.decisive_experiment: Allele-specific BUBR1 mRNA + full-length protein under NMD-inhibition alone / readthrough agent alone / combination, with SAC-competence readout.

candidates.eligibility_note: approved for urea-cycle disorders; pediatric (glycerol form >=2 months)
candidates.best_evidence: Mechanism = COPII/secretory-cargo export, NOT a cytosolic chaperone (Ma W & Goldberg J, eLife 2017, PMID 28594326). Zero BUBR1-specific data.
candidates.disposition_reason: Mechanism mismatch (BUBR1 is cytosolic/mitotic) + achievable exposure (0.2-1.3 mM total) overlaps the HDAC range. Thresholds are NOT a measured N1002K ECx -> 'direct rescue and exposure feasibility not established' (deprioritized), NOT 'no window proven'.
candidates.decisive_experiment: In-cell EC50 for N1002K-BUBR1 stabilization across 0.05-10 mM vs a histone-H3/H4-acetylation (HDAC) readout in the same cells.

candidates.eligibility_note: approved; extensive pediatric use; renally gentle
candidates.best_evidence: As a disease modifier: rejected (effective 0.5-5 mM vs reachable plasma ~2-25 uM oral). As mitigation: reduces oxidative/senescence load (consequence endpoint).
candidates.disposition_reason: Conditional as downstream mitigation (a lane the strategy permits), NOT a disease modifier; exposure for the mitigation endpoint unproven; keep tumor-promotion watch.
candidates.decisive_experiment: In patient cells: ROS + senescence markers (SA-beta-gal/p16/p21) + proliferative lifespan at achievable exposure; explicitly a mitigation readout, not a fidelity fix.

candidates.drug: AMPK aneuploid-deselection (metformin; non-renal AMPK agent needed)
candidates.eligibility_note: metformin approved/pediatric but renal-limited (FDA limit by eGFR); a non-renally-cleared AMPK activator is the open substitution
candidates.best_evidence: Tang YC et al., Cell 2011, PMID 21315436 — p53-RELATED apoptosis (Fig 3), AMPK-dependence (Fig 4), Bub1b^H/H MEFs (Fig 6). NOT p53-independent.
candidates.disposition_reason: Research question: under what cell + exposure does a selective effect exceed normal-tissue loss? Anti-proliferation is not repaired segregation. Euploid cells in constitutional BUB1B deficiency still carry the defect.
candidates.decisive_experiment: Euploid-vs-aneuploid differential viability in matched patient cells with a non-renal AMPK agent; measure normal-cell loss and p53 status; separate selection from fidelity.

gates.G1_oncology: senescence is a tumor-suppressive barrier; myelosuppression

candidates.best_evidence: Baker 2011 Nature PMID 22048312 used the INK-ATTAC GENETIC tool + AP20187 to clear p16 cells — this is NOT evidence that the D+Q DRUG rescued the disease model. Zhu 2015 Aging Cell PMID 25754370 D+Q is in Ercc1-deficient/other models. No aneuploidy endpoint in any cited study.
candidates.disposition_reason: Acts downstream; genetic-tool validation != D+Q drug evidence; endpoint mismatch (senescence markers, not aneuploidy) + toxicity on this child's organs.
candidates.decisive_experiment: Only re-enters if a patient model shows D+Q reduces the PROLIFERATING aneuploid clone fraction (scDNA-seq/micronucleus) AND does not accelerate outgrowth.

candidates.best_evidence: Aneugenic micronucleus evidence in human lymphocytes at physiologic doses; no BUB1B/SAC link.
candidates.disposition_reason: Supportive/deficiency-correction claim distinct from disease modification; dose only to the genome-stability threshold; oncology watch.
candidates.decisive_experiment: Deficiency status + aneugenic MN readout at threshold dosing; not a segregation-fidelity fix.

candidates.best_evidence: Baker 2013 (PMID 23242215) mentions a preliminary rapamycin feeding result as UNPUBLISHED DATA — a negative signal only, NOT a full dose/stat-powered pharmacological experiment.
candidates.disposition_reason: Keep as conditional on the oncologic-protective axis; the 'genome-stabilizing' story is not supported; the null is an unpublished preliminary signal, not proof of equivalence or inefficacy.
candidates.decisive_experiment: Patient-target-phenotype vs dose/exposure compatibility; do not substitute an anti-aging endpoint for patient benefit.
